title: Signal: Cargo manifest declares no licence
scope: A Cargo.toml file that declares a crate manifest that records no licence.
limitations: It matches a crate manifest that records no licence in the parsed Cargo.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A Cargo.toml that mentions a crate manifest that records no licence in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
